[
Grab’s Economic Impact in Singapore

Grab’s ride-hailing and delivery services contributed **S$5.2 billion** to Singapore’s economy in
2023. The impact supported **117,000** earning opportunities, and generated **S$2.5 billion** in
household income through in-app purchases and the economic activity it supports among the local
supply chains in the wider Singapore economy.

Learn More

[

Grab officially launched its first Artificial Intelligence Centre of Excellence (AI COE), with
support from Digital Industry Singapore (DISG). This strategic AI innovation hub aims to accelerate
AI-driven solutions that **improve digital accessibility, boost platform productivity and growth,
and contribute to smart nation building** across Southeast Asia.

Learn More

[
Grab Singapore Achieves IMDA Data Protection Trustmark (DPTM) Accreditation

Grab Singapore has been officially accredited with the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA)
Data Protection Trustmark (DPTM). This recognition reflects Grab's continuous, top-level commitment
to **strengthening digital trust** and **ensuring personal data remains safe and secure** for all
platform users.

recognised through:

* Transport Gold Award (recipient from 2022-2025) – for exemplary driver-partner service standards

Grab Singapore is a part of the government-led Platform Workers Trilateral Group (PWTG), a major
initiative designed to **address challenges and safeguard the well-being of platform workers**
amidst the rapidly evolving digital landscape. Grab works alongside the Ministry of Manpower (MOM),
Ministry of Transport (MOT), and the National Trades Union Congress (NTUC) to develop progressive
solutions.

* Subsidised medical services

Grab’s Economic Impact in Singapore

Grab’s ride-hailing and delivery services contributed **S$5.2 billion** to Singapore’s economy in
2023. The impact supported **117,000** earning opportunities, and generated **S$2.5 billion** in
household income through in-app purchases and the economic activity it supports among the local

initiative designed to **address challenges and safeguard the well-being of platform workers**
amidst the rapidly evolving digital landscape. Grab works alongside the Ministry of Manpower (MOM),
Ministry of Transport (MOT), and the National Trades Union Congress (NTUC) to develop progressive
solutions.

into work or traveling to client meetings, conferences or training sessions.

before you ride and customizable tools for added peace of mind, we’re a community built on putting
safety first.

[Learn more][18][Community guidelines][19]

essentials like groceries and healthcare. Lyft Up makes rides more accessible, bringing communities
closer.

# [CTA Seeks Next-Gen Faregate and Fare-Collection Technology][52]

Through its Innovation Studio, the CTA issued a problem statement inviting solutions to modernize
the fare-payment experience and curb fare evasion, building on ADA faregate upgrades and its
next-generation Ventra system. Why It Matters: Signals continued agency investment in frictionless
fare collection and rider experience at the station front door.
[ View Article > ][53]
Mass Transit
July 20, 2026

# [Henry County, GA Debuts Its First Fixed-Route Bus Service][54]

Henry County launched Henry Connect Route 1, connecting McDonough and Stockbridge with a two-hour
round trip and free rides for the first 30 days — the first phase of its Transit Master Plan to
expand access to jobs, school, and healthcare. Why It Matters: A textbook example of a growing
community standing up new fixed-route service — the moment agencies most need planning, scheduling,
and rider-information tools.
[ View Article > ][55]
Mass Transit (The Virginian-Pilot)
July 20, 2026

# [Free Base Express Shuttle Shatters Ridership Goals at Naval Station Norfolk][56]

Hampton Roads Transit's free Base Express service has carried more than 188,000 passengers since
December 2022 — surpassing its three-year goal of 26,000 in under a year — connecting 70,000+
service members and civilians to workplaces and amenities across the installation. Why It Matters: A
clear proof point that well-planned, rider-friendly fixed-route service on large campuses and
installations drives adoption and quality-of-life gains.
[ View Article > ][57]
METRO Magazine
July 13, 2026

# [Urban Institute: Fare-Free Pilot Expanded Mobility and Access to Opportunity][58]

An Urban Institute evaluation of Philadelphia's Zero Fare pilot found that removing fares and using
automatic enrollment increased ridership, reduced transportation barriers, and improved access to
jobs, health care, and education for low-income riders. Why it matters: The findings give agencies
evidence on how fare policy and enrollment design directly shape ridership, equity, and rider
outcomes.
[ View Article > ][59]
APTA Passenger Transport
July 13, 2026

# [APTA Charts a Practical, Human-in-the-Loop Path for AI in Transit Operations][60]

At the APTA 2026 Rail Conference, operations and technology leaders outlined how agencies can adopt
AI to boost efficiency and safety while preserving data integrity, governance, and human oversight —
from program optimization to edge-AI vehicle monitoring. Why it matters: As agencies weigh AI for
real-time operations and analytics, this framework centers the data governance and workforce
readiness that make the tools trustworthy.
[ View Article > ][61]
Federal Transit Administration (FTA)
July 13, 2026

# [FTA Opens $12M in Grants to Connect Riders to Health Care and Essential Services][62]

The FTA has opened its FY 2026 Innovative Coordinated Access and Mobility program, making roughly
$12 million in competitive grants available for coordinated and on-demand services that link older
adults, people with disabilities, and lower-income riders to health care and other essential
destinations. Applications are due September 9, 2026. Why it matters: Agencies and mobility
providers can pursue new federal funding to launch or expand coordinated, on-demand, and
non-emergency medical transportation services that close first/last-mile gaps.
[ View Article > ][63]

#### Long Wait Time Prevention for Transit Agencies: Improve Service Reliability

3 min read

June 26, 2026
* Mobility, People, Public Transit, Technology, Transit Planning, Universities
A rider arrives at a stop expecting a bus in a few minutes. Ten minutes later, they are still
waiting. By the time a rider experiences a long wait, the issue has often been building behind the
scenes for much longer. A gap in service, a delayed vehicle, or a route that drifted off schedule
earlier in the day can all contribute to the experience.

[ READ MORE POSTS ][51]

### News

Mass Transit
July 20, 2026

# [CTA Seeks Next-Gen Faregate and Fare-Collection Technology][52]

Through its Innovation Studio, the CTA issued a problem statement inviting solutions to modernize
the fare-payment experience and curb fare evasion, building on ADA faregate upgrades and its
next-generation Ventra system. Why It Matters: Signals continued agency investment in frictionless
fare collection and rider experience at the station front door.
[ View Article > ][53]
Mass Transit
July 20, 2026

# [Henry County, GA Debuts Its First Fixed-Route Bus Service][54]

Henry County launched Henry Connect Route 1, connecting McDonough and Stockbridge with a two-hour
round trip and free rides for the first 30 days — the first phase of its Transit Master Plan to
expand access to jobs, school, and healthcare. Why It Matters: A textbook example of a growing
community standing up new fixed-route service — the moment agencies most need planning, scheduling,
and rider-information tools.
[ View Article > ][55]
Mass Transit (The Virginian-Pilot)
July 20, 2026

# [Free Base Express Shuttle Shatters Ridership Goals at Naval Station Norfolk][56]

Hampton Roads Transit's free Base Express service has carried more than 188,000 passengers since
December 2022 — surpassing its three-year goal of 26,000 in under a year — connecting 70,000+
service members and civilians to workplaces and amenities across the installation. Why It Matters: A
clear proof point that well-planned, rider-friendly fixed-route service on large campuses and
installations drives adoption and quality-of-life gains.
[ View Article > ][57]
METRO Magazine
July 13, 2026

# [Urban Institute: Fare-Free Pilot Expanded Mobility and Access to Opportunity][58]

An Urban Institute evaluation of Philadelphia's Zero Fare pilot found that removing fares and using
automatic enrollment increased ridership, reduced transportation barriers, and improved access to
jobs, health care, and education for low-income riders. Why it matters: The findings give agencies
evidence on how fare policy and enrollment design directly shape ridership, equity, and rider
outcomes.
[ View Article > ][59]
APTA Passenger Transport
July 13, 2026

# [APTA Charts a Practical, Human-in-the-Loop Path for AI in Transit Operations][60]

At the APTA 2026 Rail Conference, operations and technology leaders outlined how agencies can adopt
AI to boost efficiency and safety while preserving data integrity, governance, and human oversight —
from program optimization to edge-AI vehicle monitoring. Why it matters: As agencies weigh AI for
real-time operations and analytics, this framework centers the data governance and workforce
readiness that make the tools trustworthy.
[ View Article > ][61]
Federal Transit Administration (FTA)
July 13, 2026

# [FTA Opens $12M in Grants to Connect Riders to Health Care and Essential Services][62]

The FTA has opened its FY 2026 Innovative Coordinated Access and Mobility program, making roughly
$12 million in competitive grants available for coordinated and on-demand services that link older
adults, people with disabilities, and lower-income riders to health care and other essential
destinations. Applications are due September 9, 2026. Why it matters: Agencies and mobility
providers can pursue new federal funding to launch or expand coordinated, on-demand, and
non-emergency medical transportation services that close first/last-mile gaps.

## Exclusive transit insights, right in your inbox.

## Product innovation

Transit never stands still—and neither do we. We’re constantly releasing new capabilities so you can
keep pace with the changing needs of your community.

[ Explore the latest ][41]
Via Intelligence

The first vertical AI platform designed to build best-in-class public transit. It gives city and
agency leaders powerful recommendations and automations that boost efficiency and service
performance.

[ Learn more about Via Intelligence ][42]

][46]

][47]

### Eligibility Manager

Digitize the approval process with features like AI-application scanning and 1-click letter
generation.

][48]

## Global scale, local impact.

We work with 700+ partners across the world, from rural counties to large transit agencies. Hear
from riders, mayors, agency leaders, planners and dispatchers about the difference Via has made in
their communities.

“For the first time in two and a half or three decades, we finally changed how we deliver transit.
And by all accounts, it’s been a home run.”

— **Mayor Paul TenHaken**, Sioux Falls, South Dakota
[SXF]

### 23%

Transit ridership increase in Sioux Falls, South Dakota.

“Via is a company that truly cares about the agencies they work with being successful. We've been
looking at that data recently, and the numbers are really amazing.”

— **Alicia Walker**, General Manager of Bus Operations, Trinity Metro
[Trinity metro]

### 86%

Reduction in excessively long paratransit rides in Fort Worth, Texas.

“The Camden Loop has done more than move people, it has connected communities, supported economic
activity, and made daily life more convenient for thousands. Residents constantly tell me they love
‘the Loop’.”

— **Mayor Victor Carstarphen**, Camden, New Jersey 
[Camden]

### 72%

More job access within 30 minutes in Camden, New Jersey.

“Remix enabled the MTA to meet riders where they are. With mobile commenting, riders are now able to
leave their feedback in real time, increasing our comment volumes.”

— **Project Team**, New York MTA

## About Asia Tech x Singapore

Asia Tech x Singapore (ATxSG) is Asia’s flagship technology event jointly organised by Infocomm
Media Development Authority of Singapore (IMDA) and Informa, and supported by the Singapore Tourism
Board. The event encompasses three core components: ATxSummit, ATxEnterprise, and the year-round
ATxInspire programme.

## ATxEnterprise

Organised by Informa at Singapore EXPO, ATxEnterprise is the commercial heart of ATxSG. It serves as
Asia’s central marketplace for broadcast technology, telecommunications infrastructure, satellite
communications, and enterprise solutions, bringing together the region’s tech ecosystem to showcase
innovations, build partnerships, and exchange insights that drive digital transformation.

From frontier technologies to next-generation infrastructure, ATxEnterprise connects innovators,
decision-makers, and disruptors shaping the future of Asia’s digital economy.

[Read More][37]

## ATxSummit

Hosted by IMDA at Capella Singapore, ATxSummit serves as the apex event of ATxSG, comprising two
distinct experiences: The Plenary and The Village.

The Plenary presents an invitation-only conference exploring critical themes including agentic and
embodied AI, enterprise adoption strategies, workforce adaptation, and practical governance models.

The Village curates exclusive government-to-government and government-to-business roundtables where
senior government officials, industry leaders and academia address digital challenges, alongside
symposiums, workshops, showcases, and more.

[Read More][38]

## ATxInspire

ATxInspire, a companion series to ATxSummit, hosts a year-round series of thought-provoking
discussions and presentations by industry leaders, government officials, and academics. These events
focus on cutting-edge advancements in technology, empowering the tech community to stay ahead of the
curve. Organised by IMDA, ATxInspire fosters collaboration and knowledge sharing within the tech
sector.

[Read More][39]

Media Development Authority of Singapore (IMDA) and Informa, and supported by the Singapore Tourism
Board. The event encompasses three core components: ATxSummit, ATxEnterprise, and the year-round
ATxInspire programme.

## ATxEnterprise

Organised by Informa at Singapore EXPO, ATxEnterprise is the commercial heart of ATxSG. It serves as
Asia’s central marketplace for broadcast technology, telecommunications infrastructure, satellite
communications, and enterprise solutions, bringing together the region’s tech ecosystem to showcase
innovations, build partnerships, and exchange insights that drive digital transformation.

From frontier technologies to next-generation infrastructure, ATxEnterprise connects innovators,
decision-makers, and disruptors shaping the future of Asia’s digital economy.

[Read More][37]

## ATxSummit

Hosted by IMDA at Capella Singapore, ATxSummit serves as the apex event of ATxSG, comprising two
distinct experiences: The Plenary and The Village.

The Plenary presents an invitation-only conference exploring critical themes including agentic and
embodied AI, enterprise adoption strategies, workforce adaptation, and practical governance models.

The Village curates exclusive government-to-government and government-to-business roundtables where
senior government officials, industry leaders and academia address digital challenges, alongside
symposiums, workshops, showcases, and more.

[Read More][38]

## ATxInspire

ATxInspire, a companion series to ATxSummit, hosts a year-round series of thought-provoking
discussions and presentations by industry leaders, government officials, and academics. These events
focus on cutting-edge advancements in technology, empowering the tech community to stay ahead of the
curve. Organised by IMDA, ATxInspire fosters collaboration and knowledge sharing within the tech
sector.

##### Central Analysis Bureau

# Clarity in Risk. Confidence in Decisions.

Proprietary rating and tracking system to assess risk, inform your decisions, and find clients that
fit your appetite.

## Stronger and More Profitable Operations

Access millions of safety records and powerful analytics from Central Analysis Bureau to help
insurance carriers, brokers, and fleet managers build stronger, more profitable operations.

### Underwriters

Write Accurate Policies
More Efficiently

[ See Our Solution ][26]

### Agent/Brokers

Uncover Risk Profiles
More Quickly

[ See Our Solution ][27]

### Motor Carrier Solutions

Discover New Ways to Lower Your Risk

[ See Our Solution ][28]

## The Fusable Difference

Central Analysis Bureau is part of the Fusable family of Risk and Asset intelligence data products,
alongside [**Price Digests**][29], which provides comprehensive vehicle valuations and VIN decoding
for commercial trucks and trailers.

With a focus on innovation and customer-centricity, Fusable fuses multiple datasets into new
abilities to understand your markets, sell more, and reduce risk.

[ Learn More ][30]

## Subscribe to Our Newsletter

We’re excited to provide you with impactful resources to support your success, like our new ***Risk
Index Report Newsletter***, bringing you quarterly expert insights into the motor carrier risk
industry.

Odisha initiating the journey from Temple city Bhubaneswar, Silver city Cuttack or Srikhetra Puri.

fast, reliable & comfortable taxi service across the state by trained professional drivers. Please
give a call now and experience the true essence of Odisha.

want to go in Odisha, our 24 x 7 cab service is available with well trained professional drivers

care of your transportation needs while you enjoy the beauty and colours of this magnificent state

That's not something a general-purpose chatbot can replicate.

across FinTech, Healthcare, EdTech, Logistics, Real Estate, Energy, Retail, and more. Hundreds of

#### How do I submit my article?

Prospective authors are invited to submit original papers (not being considered for publication
elsewhere) in standard format (that is provided) describing new theoretical and/or experimental
research by online as well as offline. For online paper submission kindly go through our website and
click on [SUBMIT PAPER ONLINE][82] link. www.IJSDR.org. The link “Submit Paper Online” leads you
directly to the submission system used by that journal. For offline you can send mail to
editor@ijsdr.org with the paper, details about author.

#### How much does it cost to publish in an IJSDR journal?

Publication charges are available on our website [(Click Here to Check Publication Charges).][83]
Authors have to pay the publication fees in the IJSDR Account only OR through our Online Payment
Link.

#### How much time to take publish the single research paper?

The submitted paper undergoes a Transparent Peer Review process, and authors are notified of the
acceptance or rejection status through email and SMS.

#### What happens after my article has been accepted?

If your article accepted by our editorial committee, We notify you with acceptance mail. You have to
pay publication charges and submit the required document by single mail to editor@ijsdr.org .

Prospective authors are invited to submit original papers (not being considered for publication

The submitted paper undergoes a Transparent Peer Review process, and authors are notified of the

# Lyft Fare Estimator

Pickup Location: Drop-off Location:

Planning your next Lyft ride just got easier. Our **Lyft calculator** takes the guesswork out of
your travel expenses and provides a real-time fare estimate.

## Get Your Estimate in 3 Easy Steps

### 1. Enter Pickup

Start typing your pickup address. The tool will help you find the exact spot.

### 2. Enter Drop-off

Next, enter your drop-off location to set your destination for the trip.

### 3. See Your Price!

Our calculator will instantly show you the estimated cost for your Lyft ride.

[A phone showing the Lyft app with a map and fare details.]

## What's in a Lyft Price?

Ever wonder why a ride costs what it does? The final price is a mix of a few key parts:
* **Distance:** The miles or kilometers of your trip.
* **Time:** The minutes your ride takes from start to finish.
* **Base Fare:** A flat fee for starting the ride.
* **Prime Time:** During busy hours, prices may be higher to encourage more drivers to get on the
  road.

## Comparing Your Ride Options

While Lyft is a great choice for ridesharing, it helps to compare all your options when planning a
trip. If you're also considering traditional taxi services, the [taxi cost calculator][6] can help
you estimate fares for any taxi ride in the world and make the best decision for your budget and
needs.

## Choose Your Ride

Lyft has different cars for different needs. Here are the most common ones you will see:

### Lyft

The standard, affordable ride for up to 4 people.

### Extra Comfort

Roomier rides with top rated drivers for a more relaxing trip.

### Lyft XL

An SUV or minivan that can seat up to 6 people.

### Lyft Black

Premium black car service for business or luxury travel.

## Example Fare Prices

To give you an idea of costs, here are example prices for a 5-mile, 10-minute trip in different
locations.

### Most Affordable Locations
* [Aberdeen, South Dakota][7] ($10.00)
* [Albany, Georgia][8] ($10.50)
* [Eureka, California][9] ($11.00)
* [Ardmore, Oklahoma][10] ($11.50)
* [Waterloo, Iowa][11] ($12.00)

### Higher-Priced Locations
* [New York City, New York][12] ($45.00)
* [San Francisco, California][13] ($42.50)
* [Los Angeles, California][14] ($40.00)
* [Chicago, Illinois][15] ($38.00)
* [Washington, D.C.][16] ($36.50)

## Recent Estimates

See the latest trips other users have estimated with our tool.
* [Richmond to Fort Lee][17]
* [Truckee to Gar Woods][18]
* [Truckee River to Gar Woods][19]
* [Park Ave S & 16th St E to Richfield Ice Arena][20]
* [Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport to Doral][21]
* [Buffalo-Niagara International Airport to Marriott on the Falls Hotel][22]
* [Buffalo-Niagara International Airport to Niagara Falls][23]
* [Hudson to Dunedin][24]
* [Hudson to Tampa][25]
* [Greyhound Bus Station to Minkler Street][26]

## Have More Questions?

We've got you covered. Here are our simple guides to the most common questions:
* **How do I call Lyft?**
  Getting in touch with Lyft can be tricky. We explain the best ways on our [Lyft Customer
  Service][27] page.
* **Is Lyft in my town?**
  Use our simple [Lyft Availability Checker][28] to see if you can get a ride from your address.
* **What are all the cities Lyft serves?**
  Lyft is in hundreds of places! You can see the full list on our [Lyft Cities][29] page.
* **How is Lyft's stock performing?**
  Curious about the company's financials? Check the latest charts on our [Lyft Stock Price][30]
  page.

We're not affiliated with Lyft®, but we strive to offer you the best Lyft guide. Be sure to estimate
your next Lyft trip.

# Lyft Fare Estimator

Pickup Location: Drop-off Location:

Planning your next Lyft ride just got easier. Our **Lyft calculator** takes the guesswork out of
your travel expenses and provides a real-time fare estimate.

## Get Your Estimate in 3 Easy Steps

### 1. Enter Pickup

Start typing your pickup address. The tool will help you find the exact spot.

### 2. Enter Drop-off

Next, enter your drop-off location to set your destination for the trip.

### 3. See Your Price!

Our calculator will instantly show you the estimated cost for your Lyft ride.

[A phone showing the Lyft app with a map and fare details.]

## What's in a Lyft Price?

Ever wonder why a ride costs what it does? The final price is a mix of a few key parts:
* **Distance:** The miles or kilometers of your trip.
* **Time:** The minutes your ride takes from start to finish.
* **Base Fare:** A flat fee for starting the ride.
* **Prime Time:** During busy hours, prices may be higher to encourage more drivers to get on the
  road.

## Comparing Your Ride Options

While Lyft is a great choice for ridesharing, it helps to compare all your options when planning a
trip. If you're also considering traditional taxi services, the [taxi cost calculator][6] can help
you estimate fares for any taxi ride in the world and make the best decision for your budget and
needs.

## Choose Your Ride

Lyft has different cars for different needs. Here are the most common ones you will see:

### Lyft

The standard, affordable ride for up to 4 people.

### Extra Comfort

Roomier rides with top rated drivers for a more relaxing trip.

### Lyft XL

An SUV or minivan that can seat up to 6 people.

### Lyft Black

Premium black car service for business or luxury travel.

## Example Fare Prices

To give you an idea of costs, here are example prices for a 5-mile, 10-minute trip in different
locations.

  Service][27] page.

## Information Technology Services

IT services hiring is high volume, time sensitive and unforgiving on quality. We partner with global
and domestic IT firms, consultancies and system integrators to keep their talent pipeline moving —
at every level.

[ Discover More ][122]

### Industries

## Contractual Staffing Options

From short-term project requirements to extended contractual engagements — we match the right
professionals to your needs, fast.

[ Discover More ][123]

### Industries

## Corporate & Functional Hiring

Corporate function hiring — whether Finance, HR, Marketing, or Operations — demands a different kind
of search. Deep domain understanding, discretion and precision. We bring all three.

[ Discover More ][124]

### Our Success Stories

Cloud Computing

#### Cloud Computing

We have been successful in hiring for various skills across SAAS, PAAS, IAAS, Ucaas, Cpaas, Ccaas
etc for multiple companies over the past years. Our in- depth understanding of the domain has helped
us search out specific talent in high tech skills within the cloud engineering space.

PAN India B2C Expansion

#### PAN India B2C Expansion

We have been instrumental in PAN india expansion for multiple B2C startups in the past years. From
hiring State/City heads to hiring for supply/demand professionals and setting up local marketing ops
across India, we have done it all. Some examples include customers in ride hailing, healthcare,
Hospitality, Agri /food tech, B2B marketplace, etc

Setting up Engineering Teams

#### Setting up Engineering Teams

Some of our biggest success stories involve setting up Tech Engineering teams for Indian captive
units of Global companies and Indian Startups. We adopt a consultative approach, work closely with
the HQ's engineering leadership, and become the extended arm of internal teams to achieve success
within timelines and budget. Examples include Bangalore R&D center for a fashion e-commerce company,
B2B marketplace, hotel booking major, telecom major, salesforce based AI product player, etc

Volume Hiring for IT Skills

#### Volume Hiring for IT Skills

In the past decade, our specialist recruiters have facilitated volume hiring in generic, niche,
ultraniche skills for numerous IT Services Companies. We have successfully run RPO and exclusive
engagements with large IT services companies with onboarding targets running to hundreds for many
years now. Our specialised team has consistently demostrated expertise and success in driving
generic as well as niche and ultraniche hiring for multiple locations in India.

PAN India Sales Hiring for Consumer Orgs

#### PAN India Sales hiring for Consumer Orgs

We have been successful in hiring sales professionals across the length and breadth of the country
from, from metros to Tier 3 Cities. We have serviced beverages, paint, garment, luxury goods and
e-commerce companies in this sector. Our extensive experience helps our customers get the speed and
edge over their competition in hiring for their frontline talent.

Scaling up Inside Sales & Customer Service Teams

#### Scaling up Inside Sales & Customer Service Teams

One of our most specialised service teams has catered to the hiring of inside sales and service
talent for multiple ecommerce, edtech, fintech and various other startup organisations. Our
constantly expanding internal database of readily available candidates indexed for language skills,
geography, domain skills, communication and various other parameters give us a unique advantage in
finding the right fit. From simple contingent augmentation to setting up greenfield teams, we have
done it all.

Successful RPO Engagement Across Tech & Non-Tech

#### Successful RPO Engagement Across Tech & Non-Tech

We have in the past decade been involved in multiple RPO engagements for hiring High Tech skills,
Volume IT skills, Sales professionals, Category Management professionals, driving geographical
expansions etc. We have been successful in servicing all these demands and engagements on time and
within budget time and again.  

High Tech Hiring for Product Companies and Startups

#### High Tech Hiring for Product Companies and Startups

Since our founding, we have been involved in hiring for high tech across enterprise, consumer and
startup companies. We have solved some of the most complex hiring tech problems and cracked and
staffed some of the trickiest high tech positions through headhunting, mapping and consultative
engagements, influencing comp re-engineering, JD recasting and market benchmarking.

### Our Success Stories

Cloud Computing

#### Cloud Computing

We have been successful in hiring for various skills across SAAS, PAAS, IAAS, Ucaas, Cpaas, Ccaas
etc for multiple companies over the past years. Our in- depth understanding of the domain has helped
us search out specific talent in high tech skills within the cloud engineering space.

PAN India B2C Expansion

#### PAN India B2C Expansion

We have been instrumental in PAN india expansion for multiple B2C startups in the past years. From
hiring State/City heads to hiring for supply/demand professionals and setting up local marketing ops
across India, we have done it all. Some examples include customers in ride hailing, healthcare,
Hospitality, Agri /food tech, B2B marketplace, etc

Setting up Engineering Teams

#### Setting up Engineering Teams

Some of our biggest success stories involve setting up Tech Engineering teams for Indian captive
units of Global companies and Indian Startups. We adopt a consultative approach, work closely with
the HQ's engineering leadership, and become the extended arm of internal teams to achieve success
within timelines and budget. Examples include Bangalore R&D center for a fashion e-commerce company,
B2B marketplace, hotel booking major, telecom major, salesforce based AI product player, etc

Volume Hiring for IT Skills

#### Volume Hiring for IT Skills

In the past decade, our specialist recruiters have facilitated volume hiring in generic, niche,
ultraniche skills for numerous IT Services Companies. We have successfully run RPO and exclusive
engagements with large IT services companies with onboarding targets running to hundreds for many
years now. Our specialised team has consistently demostrated expertise and success in driving
generic as well as niche and ultraniche hiring for multiple locations in India.

PAN India Sales Hiring for Consumer Orgs

#### PAN India Sales hiring for Consumer Orgs

We have been successful in hiring sales professionals across the length and breadth of the country
from, from metros to Tier 3 Cities. We have serviced beverages, paint, garment, luxury goods and
e-commerce companies in this sector. Our extensive experience helps our customers get the speed and
edge over their competition in hiring for their frontline talent.

Scaling up Inside Sales & Customer Service Teams

#### Scaling up Inside Sales & Customer Service Teams

One of our most specialised service teams has catered to the hiring of inside sales and service
talent for multiple ecommerce, edtech, fintech and various other startup organisations. Our
constantly expanding internal database of readily available candidates indexed for language skills,
geography, domain skills, communication and various other parameters give us a unique advantage in
finding the right fit. From simple contingent augmentation to setting up greenfield teams, we have
done it all.

Successful RPO Engagement Across Tech & Non-Tech

#### Successful RPO Engagement Across Tech & Non-Tech

We have in the past decade been involved in multiple RPO engagements for hiring High Tech skills,
Volume IT skills, Sales professionals, Category Management professionals, driving geographical
expansions etc. We have been successful in servicing all these demands and engagements on time and
within budget time and again.  

High Tech Hiring for Product Companies and Startups

#### High Tech Hiring for Product Companies and Startups

Since our founding, we have been involved in hiring for high tech across enterprise, consumer and
startup companies. We have solved some of the most complex hiring tech problems and cracked and
staffed some of the trickiest high tech positions through headhunting, mapping and consultative
engagements, influencing comp re-engineering, JD recasting and market benchmarking.

*Travel technology* refers to the IT and digital solutions that are applied in the tourism and

travel experience. *

easy.

offers all types of travel tech solutions including B2B, B2C, CRM and other software solutions. We
provide top-notch services by building flexible travel software solutions and reservation systems
following the latest technology trends, agile approach and innovation.

[What is travel technology?][88]
*Travel technology* refers to the IT and digital solutions that are applied in the tourism and
travel industry in order to automate travel, save time, cut expenses and give customers a smooth
travel experience. *

#### Travel technology

* enables consumers to have a seamless experience making bookings, payments, and other operations
easy.
[Which is the best travel technology company?][89]
PROVAB is an award winning travel technology company in India. It is headquartered in Bangalore &
offers all types of travel tech solutions including B2B, B2C, CRM and other software solutions. We
provide top-notch services by building flexible travel software solutions and reservation systems
following the latest technology trends, agile approach and innovation.
[How is the growth of the travel technology industry? ][90]

##### travel technology industry

is one of the fastest growing verticals with 15.4% CAGR. Last few quarters have seen price rise at
inventory level too, but still the demand is pretty much intact.

[What is the cost of travel technology solutions?][92]
Travel technology solutions typically cost between US$10,000 and US$100,000+, depending on the type
of solution, features, integrations, and customization required. Factors such as booking engines,
API integrations, mobile apps, AI features, and ongoing support can significantly influence the
overall cost.

### What is a QR Code?

QR Code is a two-dimensional version of the barcode, typically made up of black and white pixel
patterns. Denso Wave, a Japanese subsidiary of the Toyota supplier Denso, developed them for marking
components in order to accelerate logistics processes for their automobile production. Now, it has
found its way into mobile marketing with the widespread adoption of smartphones. “QR” stands for
“Quick Response”, which refers to the instant access to the information hidden in the Code.

[A person scanning a QR code on a coffee cup with their smartphone at a café]
[Tell me more][63]

### What are the benefits of using QR Codes?

They are gaining popularity because of their versatility. You can use them to gather feedback to
improve your products or services, increase customer engagement with images or videos, or even
promote your business via events and coupons. All of these can be done with just a single scan!

[Woman reviewing QR code campaign performance dashboard on laptop inside a small retail clothing
store]
[Tell me more][64]

camera app on your mobile phone and hold it over a Code for a few seconds until a notification pops
up. If this doesn’t happen, check your settings and see if QR Code scanning is enabled. Still not
working? Don’t worry, all you have to do now is install third-party QR Code readers from your app
stores.

# Make sense of chaos


Commuting in Metro Manila can be hard: that’s why we combine routes across different modes to get
you the fastest and most efficient route. It’s multi-modal magic.

Soon, we’ll also provide advisories: stay up to date on new routes, service failures, and fare
updates!

[Get directions for P2P, MRT, UV express, Jeepney, Pasig River Ferry]

# Manage your priorities


Maybe the trains are in trouble, or the jeeps got jammed in traffic. Or maybe you just happen to
like the comfort of P2P buses.

Either way, you can adjust how often modes are shown: you can prefer a mode, or choose to avoid it.

[Metro Manila map and routes data]

# The best data, from you


We’re confident that we have the best directions in Metro Manila, compared to any app or website.

But sometimes that’s not good enough. You can help us out: each leg in our directions has a
prominent area where you can submit corrections or suggestions.

# Make sense of chaos


Commuting in Metro Manila can be hard: that’s why we combine routes across different modes to get
you the fastest and most efficient route. It’s multi-modal magic.

Soon, we’ll also provide advisories: stay up to date on new routes, service failures, and fare

# Manage your priorities


Maybe the trains are in trouble, or the jeeps got jammed in traffic. Or maybe you just happen to
like the comfort of P2P buses.

Either way, you can adjust how often modes are shown: you can prefer a mode, or choose to avoid it.

[Metro Manila map and routes data]

We’re confident that we have the best directions in Metro Manila, compared to any app or website.

## About us

S&A Law Offices (“S&A”) is a full-service law firm comprising of experienced, well-recognized, and
accomplished professionals. S&A is assisting its clients in diverse practices areas.

With Registered Office at Gurugram and its other offices at New Delhi, Mumbai, along with associate
offices across India, S&A is fully equipped to provide legal services on a pan-India basis.

[Read more][37]

### Expertise

#### Litigation and ADR

Litigation and ADR Practice Group assists clients with strategic decision-making in litigation and
ADR matters.

[Learn more][38]

#### Commercial Transactions

S&A’s commercial transactions practice team assists clients in a broad range of commercial
transactions & arrangements.

[Learn more][39]

#### Corporate and Allied Laws

S&A handles domestic as well as international clients and renders services such as corporate
advisory, company formations and tax structuring

[Learn more][40]

#### Intellectual Property Rights

S&A Intellectual Property Practice Group assist clients in all types of registrations, enforcement,
commercialization, licensing/assignments, maintenance and evaluations of intellectual property
rights in India.

[Learn more][41]

#### Valuation

S&A’s Valuation services aim to help clients prevent compliance issues triggered by gaps in any
processes or by someone’s mal intention or due to loopholes in technologies implemented in
businesses.

[Learn more][42]

#### Indirect Tax, Customs & Trade

Every commercial transaction has taxation aspects, and businesses need to identify them to fulfil
their tax responsibilities.

[Learn more][43]

## About us

S&A Law Offices (“S&A”) is a full-service law firm comprising of experienced, well-recognized, and
accomplished professionals. S&A is assisting its clients in diverse practices areas.

With Registered Office at Gurugram and its other offices at New Delhi, Mumbai, along with associate
offices across India, S&A is fully equipped to provide legal services on a pan-India basis.

[Read more][37]

### Expertise

#### Litigation and ADR

Litigation and ADR Practice Group assists clients with strategic decision-making in litigation and
ADR matters.

[Learn more][38]

#### Commercial Transactions

S&A’s commercial transactions practice team assists clients in a broad range of commercial
transactions & arrangements.

[Learn more][39]

#### Corporate and Allied Laws

S&A handles domestic as well as international clients and renders services such as corporate
advisory, company formations and tax structuring

[Learn more][40]

#### Intellectual Property Rights

S&A Intellectual Property Practice Group assist clients in all types of registrations, enforcement,
commercialization, licensing/assignments, maintenance and evaluations of intellectual property
rights in India.

[Learn more][41]

#### Valuation

S&A’s Valuation services aim to help clients prevent compliance issues triggered by gaps in any
processes or by someone’s mal intention or due to loopholes in technologies implemented in
businesses.

[Learn more][42]

#### Indirect Tax, Customs & Trade

Every commercial transaction has taxation aspects, and businesses need to identify them to fulfil
their tax responsibilities.

## Financials, decoded.

Audited filings turned into three full statements, 32 ratios and a 0-100 Financial Health Score
across 8 dimensions, for every company, NBFC and LLP, going back up to a decade. Global sources do
not carry this depth for India.

#### Three full statements

Balance sheet, P&L and cash flow, standalone and consolidated, with the underlying filings.

#### 32 ratios & metrics

Liquidity, leverage, profitability, efficiency and returns, computed for every financial year.

#### Up to 10 years of history

Revenue, profit, net worth and assets with 1–10 year CAGR and trend insights.

#### Financial Health Score

A 0–100 score across 8 dimensions, with auto-generated risk factors and strengths.

#### Company, NBFC & LLP formats

Format-aware schemas so every entity type reads correctly, not forced into one template.

#### Peer & 4-way comparison

Benchmark against algorithmic peers, or compare up to four companies side by side.

Risk & compliance

## Know the risk before you commit.

The signals that matter for credit, onboarding and due diligence, pulled from courts, regulators and
registries, in one view.

#### Charges & borrowings

Open and closed charges, lenders, instruments and the exact property under charge.

#### Litigation across 5 forums

District, High & Supreme courts, NCLT and NCLAT, with hearings, orders and FIRs.

#### Regulatory actions

SEBI and RBI enforcement against companies and the people behind them.

#### Credit ratings & alerts

Ratings from CRISIL, ICRA, CARE and more, with upgrade and downgrade alerts.

#### GST & EPFO discipline

Filing and payment punctuality, MSME dues and on-time rates, month by month.

#### Auditor & CARO signals

Auditor qualifications, ~40 CARO disclosures, resignations and struck-off flags.

CIN/PAN, ROC, incorporation, status, contact, business segment.

Current & past directors, KMP, director profiles and affiliations.

Shareholding, promoter/public split, director holdings, FIIs, group structure, ODI.

Balance sheet, P&L, cash flow, 32 ratios across up to 10 years, auditors & CARO.

#### Charges, peers & related corporates

Open/closed charges, peer comparison, and potentially related entities.

#### Compliance, alerts & risk signals

Regulatory alerts + GST/EPFO/CSR/Credit rating & other compliance checks.

#### Litigation intelligence

Pending & disposed cases, filed by or against the company (where available).

# Cab Fleet Management Software for Transport & Corporate Companies

VectraRide is an end-to-end fleet management platform built for cab operators, taxi companies,
corporate transport teams, and employee shuttle services. Automate dispatching, track vehicles in
real time, manage drivers, generate invoices, and stay 100% compliant – all from one dashboard.

[ Contact Sales ][20][ View Features ][21]

## Everything You Need to Succeed

### Our comprehensive platform provides all the tools necessary to manage and grow your cab business
### efficiently.

Specialized App Suite

Access three dedicated applications each with its own secure login and tailored interface for
corporate, fleet, and school needs.

Auto-Allocation Engine

A rule-based system that synchronizes transport requests into optimized time-slots, eliminating the
need for manual dispatchers.

Compliance Shield

Proactive, automated tracking of document expiries (Insurance, Fitness, Permits) to prevent legal
fines and ensure 100% fleet legality.

Maintenance Pipeline

Direct mobile-to-web reporting that converts driver-logged road incidents into trackable maintenance
work orders instantly.

Billing & Invoicing

Automated fare calculations with strict version control—ensuring that current rate changes never
affect or corrupt your historical financial records.

Real-Time Driver & User Apps

A connected network of mobile apps for Drivers, Users, and Parents, providing live GPS tracking and
instant status updates.

## Fleet Management Software for Every Type of Transport Business

### Whether you operate a taxi fleet, manage user transport, run school cab services, or provide
### on-demand cab bookings – VectraRide is built for you.

Taxi & Cab Companies

Manage your entire taxi fleet from one platform. Automate driver allocation, track cabs in real
time, handle billing, and ensure every vehicle stays compliant. The ideal taxi fleet management
software solution for operators of any size.

Corporate Transport Teams

Streamline employee pick-up and drop scheduling, manage dedicated corporate cabs, and generate
automated invoices for HR and finance teams. VectraRide is the trusted corporate cab management
software for enterprises.

Fleet & Transport Companies

Run a smarter transport business with an automated fleet management system that handles routing,
compliance, maintenance, and reporting -so you focus on growth, not paperwork.

School & Campus Transport

Give parents peace of mind with live GPS tracking and real-time notifications. Our vehicle fleet
management system keeps school routes safe, punctual, and fully documented.

## Why Hundreds of Transport Companies Choose VectraRide

### Running a fleet is complex. VectraRide simplifies every layer - from booking to billing -with
### enterprise-grade fleet management software that works for fleets of 10 or 10,000 vehicles.
* Save 40% of dispatcher time with our automated fleet management system
* Zero compliance fines - automated document expiry alerts keep your fleet legal
* Real-time GPS fleet tracking on every vehicle, 24/7
* Billing accuracy guaranteed - no manual errors, full audit trail
* Works for taxi fleets, corporate cab services, employee transport, and school buses
* Cloud-based fleet management platform - accessible from any device, anywhere

## Frequently Asked Questions About VectraRide Fleet Management Software

What is fleet management software?+
Fleet management software is a digital platform that helps businesses manage, track, and optimize
their vehicle fleets. It covers vehicle tracking, driver management, route optimization, compliance,
maintenance, and billing - all from a single dashboard.
Is VectraRide suitable for taxi and cab companies?+
Yes. VectraRide is purpose-built for taxi fleet management. It handles driver allocation, real-time
GPS cab tracking, fare calculation, and compliance tracking - making it the ideal taxi fleet
management software for fleets of any size.
Does VectraRide support corporate employee transport?+
Absolutely. VectraRide includes dedicated corporate cab management features: employee pick-up/drop
scheduling, corporate billing, HR-friendly reports, and a dedicated employee app with live tracking
and notifications.
How does the auto-dispatch system work?+
Our automated fleet management system uses a rule-based allocation engine that matches transport
requests to available vehicles by location, time-slot, and capacity - eliminating the need for
manual dispatchers and reducing idle time across your fleet.

## Roof, thermo and battery solutions for vehicles worldwide 

[Webasto marks its 125th anniversary with a corporate anniversary logo celebrating 125 years of
innovations as a global systems partner in mobility.]

As one of the top 100 automotive suppliers worldwide, Webasto actively supports the transformation
of the industry with decades of expertise and future‑oriented products: openable and fixed roofs,
electric high‑voltage heaters, batterie systems and thermo management solutions – our portfolio
stands for technologies that enables future mobility. Building on 125 years of continuous
innovation, we design all our solutions for series production, global scalability and long‑term
reliability. This legacy drives us today as strongly as it has throughout our history.

## Products & Solutions by Webasto

Roof

## Innovative roof systems

Webasto develops advanced roof systems: openable, fixed panoramic, convertible and sensor modules
for autonomous and marine use as system partner to OEMs
[More about][31]
[Roof systems from Webasto open up new horizons]

Battery

## Electrifying battery solutions

With OEM-specific battery solutions as well as our modular, standardized battery system, we can meet
a wide variety of customer requirements. Durability, safety and performance are a matter of course
for us and guarantee sustainable solutions for clean mobility.

[More about][32]
[#]

Heating

## Comfortable warmth

Webasto heating solutions for vehicles: high-voltage, water, air, hybrid and marine heaters
delivering efficient, OEM-grade thermal comfort and engine preheat
[More about][33]
[Heating Solutions made by Webasto]

Cooling

## Customized cooling

Upgrade your comfort and reliability on the road, sea, or RV life with cooling products from
Webasto— rooftop air conditioning, parking coolers, fridges and more!

[More about][34]
[Cooling Solutions made by Webasto]

[Webasto marks its 125th anniversary with a corporate anniversary logo celebrating 125 years of

As one of the top 100 automotive suppliers worldwide, Webasto actively supports the transformation
of the industry with decades of expertise and future‑oriented products: openable and fixed roofs,
electric high‑voltage heaters, batterie systems and thermo management solutions – our portfolio
stands for technologies that enables future mobility. Building on 125 years of continuous
innovation, we design all our solutions for series production, global scalability and long‑term
reliability. This legacy drives us today as strongly as it has throughout our history.

for autonomous and marine use as system partner to OEMs

software providers. Plus, our software is designed to help every taxi business reduce operational

## How easy is it to switch from my current software?

It is super easy to switch from your current software to Yelowsoft! Our data migration team ensures
a smooth transition with zero data loss so you can keep all your ride history, driver details, and

## What integrations does Yelowsoft support?

Yelowsoft supports all third-party tool integrations. Be it local or international payment gateways,

it!

Yes! With Yelowsoft’s real-time tracking dashboard, you can see every ride, every driver, and every
